formal_statement: ∀ (n N M : ℕ) (pw : Fin N → ℕ) (lw : Fin M → ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin M → Prop) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → Function.Injective pw → Function.Injective lw → (∀ (p1 : Fin N) (l1 : Fin M), pw p1 ≠ lw l1) → (∀ p2 : Fin N, pw p2 < n) → (∀ l2 : Fin M, lw l2 < n) → ∀ R : ℕ → ℕ → Prop, R = Relation.ReflTransGen (fun ra rb => ra < rb ∧ ∃ rj, rb = n + rj ∧ rj < C.gates.length ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C rj).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ ra ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C rj).inputs) → ∀ T : ℕ → List (ℕ × ℕ) → Prop, T = (fun tt tL => ∀ Q : ℕ → List (ℕ × ℕ) → Prop, (∀ (qv qt : ℕ), qv < n → R qv qt → Q qt [(qt, qv)]) → (∀ (qj qt : ℕ) (qL1 qL2 : List (ℕ × ℕ)), qj < C.gates.length → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C qj).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → R (n + qj) qt → Q ((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C qj).inputs.getD 0 0) qL1 → Q ((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C qj).inputs.getD 1 0) qL2 → Q qt (qL1 ++ qL2)) → Q tt tL) → ∀ (p : Fin N) (l : Fin M) (top : ℕ) (L : List (ℕ × ℕ)), I p l → T top L → (∀ gv ∈ L, gv.2 = pw p ∨ gv.2 = lw l) → (L.filter (fun e1 => decide (e1.2 = pw p))).length ≤ 1 → (∀ gx ∈ L, gx.2 = pw p → ∃ q : Fin N, R (pw q) gx.1 ∧ ¬ I q l) → (∀ pz0 : Fin N, ¬ I pz0 l → ∃ (P0 : Finset (Fin N)) (Y0 : Finset (Fin M)), P0.card ≤ 1 ∧ Y0.card ≤ 2 ∧ (∀ a0 ∈ insert pz0 P0, ∀ m0 ∈ Y0, ¬ I a0 m0) ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun k0 : Fin n => decide (k0.val ∈ P0.image pw ∪ Y0.image lw)))).getD (top) false = true)
plain_statement: Points and lines are distinct input wires with incidence I, p on l; take an AND/OR circuit, each gate reading exactly two earlier wires. A skeleton tree hangs from wire t (AND nodes and input leaves reached by OR-only paths), every leaf p or l, at most one leaf p, whose leaf wire has some point off l with an OR-only path to it. Then for every point p' off l, wire t is true at some input of at most one point and two lines, with neither p' nor that point on those lines.
title: Lemma D: a skeleton subtree of p- and l-leaves with at most one p-leaf, non-tight, hangs from a wire dirty off l (AND/OR fan-in two)
